lighthouse.name: Lighthouse Isle
features: a rocky islet with cliffs, a pebble beach, tide pools, grass, a wind-bent pine and offshore skerries
a 30-block lighthouse banded white and red, a spiral stair inside, the watch room and the lamp room
the great light: sea lanterns in a glass lens, with the keeper's signal lamp beside it and a railed gallery
the keeper's cottage: hearth, bed, a half-eaten supper, fishing gear, the Lamp Log and the keeper's cat
a plank jetty on log piles with lanterns, a bell to ring for the keeper and a moored rowboat
a little walled garden, a woodpile and a rain barrel

fort.name: Tidewatch Fort
features: a stone sea fort on a reef: a battered curtain wall with crenellations and two round corner towers
a sea gate with a raised portcullis opening into an inner harbour with a pier and a moored rowboat
a three-storey keep: the mess and stores, the barracks (five bunks), the armory with training dummies and archery targets, and the captain's room with the Tide Log
the beacon brazier, an alarm bell and the Tidewatch flag on the keep roof; ballistae on the towers
a forge, a cistern, a supply cart, and the brig a smuggler broke out of

galleon.name: The Sunken Galleon
books: Last Entry of the Golden Heron
features: the Golden Heron, a 44-block three-masted treasure galleon broken in two on the sea floor
the stern half upright and half buried: sterncastle, stern gallery and gilded transom
Captain Ysolde Marrow's cabin: her last log on a lectern, her chest, a fallen chandelier
the strongroom in the hold behind a bent iron grille: the Crown gold (the big prize)
the bow half rolled onto its side a little way off, with its heron figurehead and the galley
the main mast still standing with a torn sail; the fore and mizzen masts fallen across the sand
a debris field of spilled cargo and the ship's anchor
barnacles, kelp, coral and sand drifts; the drowned captain on her deck and her crew in the hold

whale.name: The Whalefall
features: the bones of a colossal whale (about 45 blocks long) on the deep sea floor: a great skull with its jaws agape, a curving spine, high arching ribs (some broken and fallen), long flippers and tail flukes
a reef growing on the bones: bone-eating red tube worms, coral fans, glow lichen, sea pickles, kelp and seagrass
clay pots in the skull and the old belly hold ambergris; an old harpoon hangs in the skull
a lost diver: skull, rusted helmet, cut lifeline, kit chest and a last note
tropical fish and a glow squid live in the ribs

temple.name: The Drowned Sanctum
features: a pylon facade half sunk in the sand; over the half-buried great door, the great carved eye of the Old Tide (dark prismarine ring, sea lantern iris, black pupil)
a flooded nave of stone columns and prismarine arches with side aisles; the roof fallen in, one column toppled across the floor
three guardians wake in the nave
a grand stair down into the sunken sanctum: the altar with the Old Tide trident relic and the altar chest beneath it, watched by a second great eye
offering niches with Old Tide pots in the aisles and in the sanctum walls
a sealed reliquary behind the dark sanctum wall, reached only through a crack beside the altar: sherd pots, an inscription, a thief who never left
sand drifting in through the door; coral and kelp reclaiming the breached east gallery
outside: a fallen colonnade of the outer precinct and a leaning eye obelisk with its tip in the sand

grotto.name: The Pearl Grotto
features: a domed sea cave half sunk into the floor, lined with glow lichen and sea-glass crystals, entered by a tunnel from a coral reef
giant clams with pearls on a sandy floor, sea pickles everywhere, coral and swaying kelp
the pearl divers' camp up in a dry air pocket in the dome: plank ledge, bed, lantern, a tally of pearls and the Pearling Book; swim up through the hole in the ledge to breathe
the divers' hoard, buried under the sand where three little lights sit in a row

bell.name: Wexley's Diving Bell
features: Wexley's salvage barge at the surface: a winch and shear-leg crane, his hut and his Dive Book
a chain from the crane straight down to the copper diving bell on the sea floor
inside the bell a real air pocket: a bench, a lantern, "AIR. Breathe slow." and the diving helmet
salvage scattered around the bell: crates, a toppled cart of ingots, a broken second helmet
the crew of the last dive, drowned beside the bell

smugglers.name: Smugglers' Rock
features: a tall sea stack with banded rock, ledges, a wave-cut notch, gull nests and bushes on its crown
a sea arch into a hidden cove: a plank dock, a moored sloop with its sail furled, and a storage loft with a hoist
contraband everywhere: spice, silk, pearls and powder in crates and barrels; a stash hidden under the dock
tunnels up to the bunk room, a switchback stair to the chief's den with the ledger "No Names on the Water"
a rope-ladder chimney to the lookout on the summit, with a signal lantern and a spyglass

iceberg.name: The Frozen Hold
features: a huge iceberg of packed and blue ice, snow-capped, with powder-snow cracks on top
the Northward locked in the ice at the waterline: her bow, bowsprit and bear figurehead jut from one face, two frozen masts with a yard and a stiff torn sail from the top
a crevasse climbs from the sea into an ice vault over her deck
below deck, dry and frozen: the crew's bunks and their last meal, the hold, the captain's cabin
Captain Arvid Strand's log, which ends mid-sentence; the frozen crew below deck
a drifting floe with the boat two of the crew tried to sail south in

vents.name: The Ember Vents
features: a field of hydrothermal chimneys (10 to 19 blocks tall) of basalt, blackstone, tuff and glowing magma veins on the deep sea floor, flecked with gilded blackstone
magma mouths drag the water down in whirling bubble columns; one old vent breathes out instead (a rising column where a diver can catch their breath)
red tube worms, glow lichen and dead coral crowd around the chimneys
an Old Tide fire-shrine: a dark prismarine and blackstone platform, broken columns, a great one-eyed carving whose pupil still burns, magma braziers, an altar chest of black pearls and offering pots
deep lurkers rise when you come near the shrine; a glow squid drifts between the chimneys
